museum.onchain.title: 6529 Network Museum on Ethereum (preview)
museum.onchain.description: An unlinked test that reads the 6529 Network Museum from a ProvenanceRegistry contract on the Sepolia test network and shows each record only after its bytes match the chain.
museum.onchain.notice: Test preview, read from a Sepolia test registry and IPFS. Not the Museum's record on Ethereum mainnet.
museum.onchain.heading: The Museum, read from the chain
museum.onchain.intro: Every work, artist, record and text below was fetched from IPFS and shown only after its hash matched the one the Museum stored in its Ethereum registry.

museum.onchain.verification.heading: How this is checked
museum.onchain.verification.lead: For each record, this page reads the content ID and hash the Museum stored in its registry contract, fetches the bytes by that content ID from IPFS, hashes them, and shows the record only if the two hashes are equal.
